"""Reproduce ticket: db_collation on pk must propagate to referencing FK columns."""
import django
from django.conf import settings

settings.configure(
    DEBUG=True,
    DATABASES={"default": {"ENGINE": "django.db.backends.sqlite3", "NAME": ":memory:"}},
    INSTALLED_APPS=["django.contrib.contenttypes", "django.contrib.auth"],
    USE_TZ=True,
)
django.setup()

from django.db import models, connection
from django.db.migrations.state import ProjectState
from django.db.migrations.autodetector import MigrationAutodetector
from django.db.migrations.loader import MigrationLoader
from django.db.migrations.writer import MigrationWriter
from django.db.migrations import Migration

# --- "before" state: BigAutoField pks ---
class AccountOld(models.Model):
    class Meta:
        app_label = "manage"

class AddressOld(models.Model):
    account = models.OneToOneField(AccountOld, on_delete=models.CASCADE)
    class Meta:
        app_label = "manage"

class ProfileOld(models.Model):
    account = models.ForeignKey("AccountOld", null=True, blank=True, on_delete=models.CASCADE)
    class Meta:
        app_label = "manage"

# --- "after" state: collated CharField pks (as in the ticket) ---
class Account(models.Model):
    id = models.CharField(primary_key=True, db_collation="utf8_bin", max_length=22)
    class Meta:
        app_label = "manage"

class Address(models.Model):
    id = models.CharField(primary_key=True, db_collation="utf8_bin", max_length=22)
    account = models.OneToOneField(Account, on_delete=models.CASCADE)
    class Meta:
        app_label = "manage"

class Profile(models.Model):
    id = models.CharField(primary_key=True, db_collation="utf8_bin", max_length=22)
    account = models.ForeignKey("Account", null=True, blank=True, on_delete=models.CASCADE)
    class Meta:
        app_label = "manage"

from_state = ProjectState.from_apps(
    type("Apps", (), {"get_app_configs": lambda self: []})()
)
# build states properly
from django.apps.registry import Apps as RegApps

def make_state(*models_list):
    reg = RegApps()
    reg.populate([])
    st = ProjectState()
    for m in models_list:
        st.add_model(m)
    return st

before = make_state(AccountOld, AddressOld, ProfileOld)
after = make_state(Account, Address, Profile)

autodetector = MigrationAutodetector(before, after)
changes = autodetector._detect_changes()
ops = []
for app_label, miglist in changes.items():
